notes:
I searched for toddler underwater basket weaving lessons in Halton Hills specifically. This turns out to be a well-known idiom/joke phrase rather than a real activity — the search results are all humor sites, satirical "universities," and joke product listings, with nothing resembling an actual local program, let alone one for toddlers in Halton Hills.

Given this, there are no real, verifiable programs to hand back.
